Dr. Subhash Vijayran vs Shimray Asaiwo Bellrose on 8 May,
2025
 $~15
 * In Thehighcourtof Delhiatnew Delhi

+ Cont.Cas(C) 630/2025
 Dr. Subhash Vijayran 
 Through: Pe
 versus
 Shimray Asaiwo Bellrose .....Responde

Through: Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak, Stand  Counsel along with Mr. Sunil K  Jha, Mr. M.S. Akhtar, Mr. Diva  Kapil, Advs.
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 08.05.2025 1.

Pursuant to previous order dated 24th April 2025, counsel for respondent hands up case status showing that the reference has now been sent on 3rd May 2025, with respect to the complaint regarding the share of the compensation, which has been raised by the petitioner.
2. Copy of the same has been handed over to thepetitioner as well.
3. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
4. Needless to state, further procedures as under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 will be complied with.
5. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
This is a digitally signed order.
